verdict.rationale: Notte documents cloud sessions as isolated browser instances you control programmatically (notte-docs-24), with a CDP endpoint for Playwright (notte-docs-11) and session start via API (notte-docs-37). Its only fleet-scale claim is the marketing line "fast, scalable browsers" (notte-docs-1), so the programmatic session management half of the story is covered but the concurrency half is not. Missing for 10: documented concurrency limits or per-plan concurrent-session quotas, explicit evidence of running many parallel sessions, fleet-level management APIs (list or bulk-stop sessions), and independent corroboration of performance at scale.
